test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'tends.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us discuss the meanings of the given options:

 
 
• **Bears**: to be able to accept and deal with something unpleasant. (अप्रिय वस्‍तु या स्थिति को सहने और उनसे निपटने की योग्‍यता रखना)
 
• **Feeds**: to give food to a person or an animal. ((मनुष्‍य या पशु को) खिलाना, भोजन देना)
 
• **Keeps**: to continue to be in a particular state or position. (किसी विशेष अवस्‍था या स्थिति में बने रहना)
 
• **Tends**: to usually do or be something. (प्रायः कुछ करना या होना, प्रवृत्ति या झुकाव होना)
 
 
 
• The given sentence is talking about the tendency of the young generation.

 

Correct Paragraph__: *While the older generation of Indians would buy a new product only when the (1) __previous__ one's useful life had ended, the young generation (2) **__tends__ **to fall for novelty. Young people want the ______(3)______ gadgets because they have money and more ______(4)______ to such goods. They are made to believe, by ______(5)______ publicity, that the new products will enhance their happiness.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us see the synonyms of the given words:

 
 
• Bear: Support
 
• Feed: Nourish
 
 

43:T1304,

The correct answer is 'latest.'
